target.title: QA-lab runtime-parity JSON bound
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`loadRuntimeParityMockToolCalls` in `extensions/qa-lab/src/runtime-parity.ts` parsed the mock debug endpoint body with unbounded `response.json()`. An oversized response could consume arbitrary memory.

## Why This Change Was Made

The JSON body is now read with `readProviderJsonResponse` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/provider-http`, which applies a 16 MiB byte cap and cancels the stream on overflow. This aligns the QA-lab runtime-parity path with other provider JSON readers.

## User Impact

Runtime parity comparisons are resilient to unexpectedly large mock debug responses; the runtime no longer buffers an unbounded JSON payload.

## Evidence

- Regression test added in `extensions/qa-lab/src/runtime-parity.test.ts` mocks an oversized JSON response and asserts `loadRuntimeParityMockToolCalls` returns null instead of buffering the body.
- Real behavior proof script in `scripts/proof/qa-lab-runtime-parity-json-bound.mts` starts a local HTTP server returning a 20 MiB JSON-like body and verifies the bounded path discards it safely.

### Local verification commands

```bash
pnpm test extensions/qa-lab/src/runtime-parity.test.ts
OPENCLAW_OXLINT_SKIP_PREPARE=1 node scripts/run-oxlint.mjs \
  extensions/qa-lab/src/runtime-parity.ts \
  extensions/qa-lab/src/runtime-parity.test.ts \
  scripts/proof/qa-lab-runtime-parity-json-bound.mts
node --import tsx scripts/proof/qa-lab-runtime-parity-json-bound.mts
```

### Proof script output

```
=== Proof: qa-lab runtime-parity JSON bound ===

Local server returning 20971520 bytes at http://127.0.0.1:38451

PASS: oversized mock debug response was discarded (returned null).
```


---

Supersedes #101130, which was auto-closed by the `r: too-many-prs` policy and could not be reopened via API.
